brief: A Market Ear flow-forensic roundup compiling quoted positioning and flow data from GS Prime, JPM Positioning Intelligence (PI), BofA and MS QDS. GS Prime reports hedge fund gross leverage at the 49th percentile overall (Fundamental L/S gross at the 21st percentile, 1-year lookback) and net leverage lower still, at the 20th percentile overall (Fundamental L/S net at the 15th percentile). JPM's US Tactical Positioning Monitor sits at the 40th percentile. BofA flow data shows equities absorbing the smallest inflow in 9 weeks, the biggest private-client outflow since October 2025, and the biggest outflow from tech funds since June 2026. GS notes the Nasdaq-100 has been consolidating for roughly 4-5 months with its multiple contracting toward multi-year lows. JPM PI reports a turn: after a couple months of reductions, North America gross flows have swung back to additions, with both longs and shorts added, though net flows remain choppier and still neutral on a 4-week basis. MS QDS flags light put positioning, calling hedges attractive.
